claims.statement: KnowledgeRuntimeService.resolveCanonicalOkfBase() resolves the OKF base from the OKF_BASE env var when set, defaulting to the repo-root 'knowledge' directory (CANONICAL_OKF_PATH), and throws KNOWLEDGE_RUNTIME_PACKAGES_KNOWLEDGE_NOT_CANONICAL when the resolved candidate realpaths to the legacy packages/knowledge directory, and KNOWLEDGE_RUNTIME_OKF_BASE_MISSING when the candidate does not exist (unless allowMissing).

The OKF bundle consists of six fixed folders — skills, agents, memory, services, repos, models — each containing markdown files parsed for frontmatter; every file's SHA-256 raw-content hash prefix (first 12 hex chars) serves as the projected capability version so edits are detected as drift.

Capability sync apply is gated by an operator-managed trusted Python validator: OKF_VALIDATOR_PATH must be an absolute path (relative values are rejected with fail status), defaulting to tools/validate_okf.py beside the bundle; a missing script or non-zero exit yields status fail, and syncCapabilities throws KNOWLEDGE_RUNTIME_OKF_VALIDATION_FAILED on apply unless validation status is exactly 'pass' — dry-run previews remain available.

The validator executes via execFileSync (no shell) as python3 -B with OKF_BASE set to the realpath of the actual data bundle, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, a 10-second timeout and SIGKILL; request-supplied commands are never accepted and misconfiguration never silently falls back.

syncCapabilities projects skills/, agents/, and services/ markdown into swarm_capabilities rows keyed as skill:<slug>/specialist:<slug>/service:<slug> with kind skill/specialist_agent/memory_source, upserting ON CONFLICT(id) with all columns replaced; dry runs (the default) write nothing to the database.

Each OKF capability file must carry six contract keys (allowed_actions, forbidden_actions, required_evidence, risk_ceiling, eval_threshold, removal_strategy); each missing key adds a missing_<key> blocked_reason, and complete files sync as status 'validated' with eval_score 0.8 while incomplete files sync as 'candidate' with eval_score 0.2 and conservative fallbacks (advisory_only, route_live_workers forbidden, contract_completion_required evidence, 'Disable capability until OKF contract is completed.' removal strategy).

Synced capability metadata records okf_path, full okf_hash, okf_folder, source 'okf', a 240-char body_excerpt, and optional agent_skill_id/agent_skill_version/agent_skill_content_hash/agent_skill_manifest_hash linking the registry entry to an installed runtime skill; latest_validation_report points back at the bundle-relative file path.

The health() report folds path resolution, validate_okf status/command/stdout/stderr, per-folder counts, and a drift section (okf_skill_count vs registered kind='skill' capability count, missing_registry_entries, stale_registry_entries by hash version mismatch, packages_knowledge_is_canonical, projection_status currently 'unknown') into blocked_reasons and next_safe_actions; valid requires exists && validate pass && no blocked reasons.

Drift detection maps registered skill capabilities to OKF slugs via metadata okf_path basename or the skill: id prefix; missing registry entries add blocked_reason KNOWLEDGE_RUNTIME_CAPABILITY_SYNC_REQUIRED, and a base that realpaths to packages/knowledge adds KNOWLEDGE_RUNTIME_PACKAGES_KNOWLEDGE_NOT_CANONICAL.

Knowledge routes in packages/server/src/routes/swarm-knowledge.ts mount inside the swarm router and expose GET /knowledge/runtime (read:evidence, health payload), POST /knowledge/sync (write:swarm_action, syncCapabilities, dry-run by default), and GET /runtime-readiness; service errors map to HTTP 404 (OKF base missing), 409 (packages/knowledge canonical), and 422 (validation failed).

The platform deep-health endpoint GET /health/deep (routes/health.ts) runs KnowledgeRuntimeService.health() and marks the knowledgeRuntime check 'error' (503 overall response) when the base is missing or validate_okf status is not pass, otherwise 'ok' with blocked_reasons surfaced as the message.

KnowledgeMaintenanceService, enabled by KNOWLEDGE_MAINTENANCE_ENABLED='true' (interval KNOWLEDGE_MAINTENANCE_INTERVAL_MS, default 15 min, ledger keyed on UTC day/ISO week), runs a daily okf_sync_drift dry-run syncCapabilities that turns created+updated>0 into a labelled work item and a weekly okf_lint that flags empty or frontmatter-less OKF markdown under the resolved base.

The MCP server registers five read-only okf_* tools (okf_search, okf_get, okf_related, okf_validate, okf_status) that resolve OKF_BASE or search for a sibling djimitflo-knowledge/okf/ directory — with no packages/knowledge legacy guard and no Python validation — and traverse the whole bundle tree including [[wiki-style]] links up to depth 3.

OkfKnowledgeUpdater is a best-effort write path that, after a judge verdict that is neither contradicted nor unverifiable, creates or appends to concepts/<slug>.md under the canonical base and logs actions in the okf_knowledge_updates ledger table, returning false silently on any failure.

isWithinOkfRoot()/validateOkfPath() enforce a G15.1 path allowlist: any path must realpath to at or under the canonical repo knowledge root, otherwise validateOkfPath throws KNOWLEDGE_RUNTIME_OKF_PATH_ESCAPE; resolveEvidenceRef verifies kind/existence of typed evidence references (goal, loop, capability, memory, trace, etc.) against their database tables.

Validator pass means structural acceptance only, not certification: the README documents OKF_VALIDATOR_PATH as a trusted operator-managed validator whose absence or failure blocks sync apply while noting structural acceptance is not certification, and the service comments state structural evaluation never implies applied outcomes or promotion/merge authority.

Loop-learning closure in closeLoop is retired (batch M1): runs that fail revalidation return a blocked closure with reason codes and stored closures are replayed after revalidation, but a passing run with no stored closure now returns blocked with loop_learning_closure_retired, writing no new eval, reflection, memory candidate, or work item.

closeLoop is exposed as POST /evolution/close-loop (write:governance) in the swarm-governance router, replayed closures are re-bound to verified self-improvement records as structural evaluation evidence, and OkfKnowledgeUpdater is the separate best-effort success path writing concepts/<slug>.md under the canonical base logged in okf_knowledge_updates.

The embedding provider factory createEmbeddingProvider defaults to an Ollama provider (ollama:<model>, default nomic-embed-text at 127.0.0.1:11434, 30s timeout), supports an openai-compatible provider that requires EMBEDDING_BASE_URL and EMBEDDING_API_KEY, throws on unsupported providers, validates every vector as a non-empty finite number array, and wraps each request in measured() so one model-call-ledger row records the model (never the input text).

VectorMemoryService defaults to the ollama-embedding-provider OllamaEmbeddingProvider (5s timeout, /api/embed with a single 404 retry to /api/embeddings, EMBEDDING_TEXT_REQUIRED for blank input) and persists memories in vector_memories with the SQLite row as source of truth: getMemory re-reads the durable row and liveEntries() evicts cache entries whose rows disappeared, while recordFeedback persists rewards in vector_feedback replayed at boot into per-memory Thompson bandit states scored 0.6*dense + 0.2*sparse + 0.2*bandit.

The vector-memory HTTP surface lives on the apex router (POST /memory/store requiring write:claim, GET /memory/search with 1-100 bounded limit, GET /memory/clusters, GET /memory/stats requiring read:evidence); server boot wires one VectorMemoryService into ReasoningBankService while the apex router instantiates its own instance, rows stored by another provider are lazily re-embedded on access, a background worker purges rows whose TTL elapsed, and retention prunes ttl-less rows.

Knowledge gaps are gated by KNOWLEDGE_GAP_MODE (default off, shadow = record only): the LoopDaemon calls recordFailureGaps on every unverified run outcome, recording one knowledge_gap judgment per failure signature recurring >= 3 times in 14 days (excluding runs attributed reviewer_failure/environment_failure) with lane/gate/error_class/files/example runs; recordAbstentionGap records one gap per question term-set per window on no_capability_match abstentions; each gap also calls CapabilityAcquisitionService.emitCapabilityGap to create a knowledge-gap:<signature> candidate skill capability that is never auto-promoted; recorders are fail-soft; and open gaps feed only shadow gap_trial_candidates in interest-feedback and the evolution-evidence knowledge_gaps section (insufficient with nulls while off).

The /api/knowledge router (routes/knowledge.ts) exposes the G15 knowledge-bus surface: POST /publish (write:claim) validates and publishes a typed claim on the in-process KnowledgeBus, GET /subscribe/:capabilityId opens an SSE stream of claims (all = wildcard), and GET /events returns the most recent swarm_claims rows (limit 1-500, default 50).
